title: Worksheet 1: What Is an Algorithm? (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: An algorithm is a set of step-by-step instructions used to complete a task or solve a problem. Just like a recipe tells a cook exactly what to do in order, an algorithm tells a computer exactly what steps to follow. For example, imagine you want a computer to make a peanut butter sandwich. The algorithm might say: 1) get two slices of bread, 2) spread peanut butter on one slice, 3) spread jelly on the other slice, 4) put the slices together. If the steps are out of order, or a step is missing, the sandwich will not turn out right. Computers cannot guess what you mean, so algorithms must be written in a very clear and exact order. Programmers write algorithms before they write actual code, so they can plan out the logic first.
